thesis: Philosophical competence primarily requires honest clarification and proportionate accountability, not universal moral authority.

ideas.statement: Address strong opposing arguments, reveal assumptions and foreseeable uses, and avoid both elegant evasion of urgent help and certainty that blocks correction.

evidenceAndExamples.statement: Authors cannot control every distortion; abstract inquiry need not prove immediate utility and finite thinkers need not become universal saviors.

objectionsAndQualifications.statement: Authors cannot control every distortion; abstract inquiry need not prove immediate utility and finite thinkers need not become universal saviors.

audit.notes: Every batch unit read directly; moral disagreement and finite demands retained.
